## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: neutral risk ratios across the dashboard (VXX flagged NEUTRAL; SPY_TLT NEUTRAL) and mixed ETF trends with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) while some volatility/commodity ETFs remain depressed (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%)).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit and fear are quiescent: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21%) signal stable credit; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) shows lower near-term fear which supports risk appetite.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-accommodative: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) are both positive, leaving stocks vs bonds effectively neutral (SPY_TLT NEUTRAL) and financial conditions steady.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leadership intact: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) alongside momentum ETFs MTUM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +15.83%); Energy is the clear laggard with XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%). Style: Growth/momentum showing strength but overall breadth is mixed.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperformance but EM rebound: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +5.57%) are strong, while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) signals EM catch-up and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -7.52%) shows China-specific weakness.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation intact but selective: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) show risk-on positioning, while IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%) keeps crypto-related flows under pressure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base/industrial metals moderate: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) while gold GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) is in short-term bounce and precious metals like SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) are weak.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under heavy pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and crude proxies USO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) / BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) have collapsed, while natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) is bouncing.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Core risk rally visible in XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%), QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +5.57%), and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%). DIVERGENCE: several sector ETFs in CORRECTION (XRT CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +9.17%), XAR CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +9.57%)) indicate short-term profit-taking.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) and MTUM (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +15.83%) while reducing exposure to Energy XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and commodity-levered ETFs; monitor China FXI (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -7.52%) and crypto IBIT (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%) for directional shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) and Biotech XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +10.99%) showing strength. BEARISH: Energy XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and Metals SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) under pressure.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) as a tactical rebound. BEARISH: Crude proxies USO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) remain stressed.

13. Key Levels?  
Watch VXX activity given current low readings VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) as a gauge of complacency; monitor HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) vs LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21%) for credit tone; XLK/XLF relative pivot to signal growth vs value leadership shifts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and multiple risk indicators reading neutral. Technology and momentum ETFs are showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND; MTUM ABOVE TREND) while Energy and commodity proxies are the primary weakness to monitor as a key divergence.
